title_ar: الشيخ الددو يشارك في مؤتمر الأمة لنصرة الشعب السوري
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Takes Part in the Ummah Conference in Support of the Syrian People
body_ar: شارك الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء بموريتانيا في مؤتمر الأمة لنصرة الشعب السوري المختتم قبل أمس 03 يوليو 2012 بمدينة اسطنبول بتركيا والمنظم من طرف رابطة العلماء السوريين. وقد ألقى فضيلة الشيخ الددو كلمة بالمناسبة قال فيها إن الحضور الغزير لعلماء المسلمين وممثلي الشعوب الحرة لهذا المؤتمر دليل على أن الأمة الإسلامية تقف كلها اليوم مع الشعب السوري في محنته، وأن الجميع مطالب بتقديم النصرة والعون للسوريين لأن الدم واحد والقضية واحدة. وأشار الشيخ الددو إلى أن بشار الأسد ليس أول طاغية يقصمه الله ولن يكون آخر طاغية، مؤكدا أن اليوم الذي سينتقم الله منه فيه صار قريبا. وخاطب الشيخ الددو علماء سوريا قائلا: لقد أبديتم أنكم مجاهدون بحق، وبينتم أن العلماء العاملين لا يتأخرون وقت المشكلات، فأثبتم أنكم القادة، وأظهرتم للعالم مستوى عاليا من الشجاعة والصدق، وذكرتمونا بمقولة الشيخ عز الدين القسام: إن الزعامة والطريق مخوفة00 غير الزعامة والطريق أمان. لمتابعة الكلمة اضغط هنا:
body_en:
Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars in Mauritania, took part in the Ummah Conference in Support of the Syrian People, which concluded the day before yesterday, 3 July 2012, in the city of Istanbul in Turkey, and was organised by the League of Syrian Scholars.

Sheikh al-Dedew delivered an address on the occasion, in which he said that the abundant attendance of Muslim scholars and of the representatives of free peoples at this conference is evidence that the Islamic community stands today, all of it, with the Syrian people in their ordeal; and that everyone is called upon to offer support and aid to the Syrians, because the blood is one and the cause is one.

Sheikh al-Dedew pointed out that Bashar al-Assad is not the first tyrant God has broken and will not be the last tyrant, affirming that the day on which God will take vengeance upon him has drawn near.

Sheikh al-Dedew addressed the scholars of Syria, saying: "You have shown yourselves to be truly men of struggle; you have made plain that scholars who act do not hang back at the time of troubles; so you have proved that you are the leaders, and you have shown the world a high degree of courage and of truthfulness. You have reminded us of the saying of Sheikh Izz al-Din al-Qassam: *leadership when the road is fearful is not the same as leadership when the road is safe.*"

*[Site link: "To follow the address, click here:"]*

flags.arabic: بشار الأسد ليس أول طاغية يقصمه الله ولن يكون آخر طاغية ... اليوم الذي سينتقم الله منه فيه صار قريبا
flags.context: the Sheikh's address, as the news desk reports it
options: translate faithfully and refer the publication decision upward
translate and publish as ordinary content
flags.note: EDITORIAL REVIEW, style guide section 12, and among the sharpest passages in this slice. A named sitting head of state is called a tyrant, and God's vengeance upon him is said to be near. In its moment — Istanbul, July 2012, a conference of Syrian scholars in exile — this was one thing; carried into English now, under the Sheikh's name and searchable, it bears on his safety and his standing in more than one jurisdiction. It has been rendered exactly: 'يقصمه' is God breaking or shattering him, and that force is kept; nothing is softened and nothing sharpened. The decision on publication belongs to Ummah Collective and the Sheikh's office.

flags.context: the Sheikh addressing the scholars of Syria
options: you have shown yourselves to be truly men of struggle
you have shown that you are true mujāhidīn
you have proved yourselves genuine fighters in God's cause
flags.note: The single most consequential word in the record and the reason the rendering is flagged rather than fixed. mujāhid spans a wide range, from one who exerts himself in any worthy effort to one who takes up arms; addressed to scholars, at a conference of scholars, who are praised in the same breath for not hanging back and for courage and truthfulness, the natural reading is moral and public steadfastness rather than combat. But the word was spoken about the Syrian conflict in 2012 and an English reader will hear the armed sense. 'Men of struggle' is deliberately as broad as the Arabic and deliberately not the transliteration, which in English has acquired a narrower and more loaded meaning than mujāhid carries here. A reviewer with the recording should settle this; it must not be settled by the translator.

flags.arabic: إن الزعامة والطريق مخوفة00 غير الزعامة والطريق أمان
flags.context: a saying attributed by the Sheikh to Izz al-Din al-Qassam
options: leadership when the road is fearful is not the same as leadership when the road is safe
to lead when the way is dangerous is other than to lead when the way is safe
leadership on a road of fear is not leadership on a road of safety
flags.note: Quoted from memory, in the balanced two-part form of a line of verse, and attributed to Izz al-Din al-Qassam, the Syrian-born preacher killed near Haifa in 1935. Rendered as prose in italics per style guide section 4; no rhymed English attempted. Note the '00' in the Arabic: the source's rendering of the two dots that mark the caesura between hemistichs, an artefact of the CMS and not part of the text.

options: the Ummah Conference in Support of the Syrian People
the Conference of the Community for the Victory of the Syrian People
the Nation's Conference to Aid the Syrian People
flags.note: naṣr/nuṣrah covers giving victory, giving aid and standing by. In a conference title addressed to a people under bombardment it carries both material and moral senses, and the record's own phrase 'support and aid' keeps that range. 'Support' is used rather than 'victory', which would narrow it to the military. الأمة is left as Ummah in the title, being the conference's own name, and rendered 'the Islamic community' in the body.

translator_notes: A news-desk report, but one that quotes the Sheikh's address directly at some length; the closing paragraph is given as his own words. The address itself exists only as the recording the record points to.
The CMS timestamp, 5 July 2012, is a bulk-upload date; the body dates the conference's close to 3 July 2012.

Note that the Sheikh was in Cairo on 3 July (record 799) and met the Egyptian president on 4 July (record 800), while this record has the Istanbul conference concluding on 3 July. Whether he attended in person for the close, or the desk is reporting an address given earlier in the conference, the corpus does not establish.
'رابطة العلماء السوريين' is the League of Syrian Scholars, a body of Syrian religious scholars formed in exile.
